texts.title: Multi-Currency
texts.tagline: Any currency. One wallet. Zero friction.
texts.description: Hold, convert, and move money across currencies without juggling multiple providers or bank accounts.
texts.who:
Cross-border platforms, global payroll,
and remittance flows that need
same-day delivery in the recipient's
local currency, anywhere.

what: Pay-in and pay-out in any supported currency, fiat or stablecoin.
Fund once, move anywhere. Convert and settle on local rails in each corridor.
Plugs directly into Disbursement and Virtual Accounts capabilities.
keyApis: Webhook for balance and conversion events.

pricing.text: FX spread on conversion. Rate by corridor.
